description: Armor/shield registry - see CLAUDE.md's Armor section for authoring guidelines. Armor grants Block (heavy armor/shields) or Dodge (light armor) only while equipped, and passively reduces incoming damage by damageReduction while equipped, regardless of which skill was rolled to defend.

armor.name: Leather Armor
armor.description: Simple, flexible protection stitched from boiled leather. Light enough to duck and weave in.

armor.name: Chainmail
armor.description: Interlocking steel rings, heavy but dependable against a glancing blow.

armor.name: Plate Armor
armor.description: A full suit of fitted steel plate. Slow going, but very little gets through it.

armor.name: Wooden Buckler
armor.description: A small round shield, strapped to the forearm. Cheap, light, and just enough to catch a blade.

armor.name: Tower Shield
armor.description: A wall of banded steel nearly as tall as its bearer. Exhausting to hold up, but almost nothing gets past it.

armor.name: Thick Sweater
armor.description: A bulky knit sweater pulled from a closet. Not much, but it takes the edge off a glancing blow.

armor.name: Couch Cushion Padding
armor.description: Foam cushions lashed to the torso with duct tape. Ridiculous to look at, surprisingly absorbent.

armor.name: Garden Gloves
armor.description: Thick canvas gloves meant for pulling weeds. Better than bare knuckles.

armor.name: Work Gloves
armor.description: Reinforced leather gloves from a hardware store. Grippy, tough, and good in a scrap.

armor.name: Steel-Toe Boots
armor.description: Heavy work boots with reinforced caps. Not built for combat, but good for standing your ground.

armor.name: Trash Can Lid Shield
armor.description: A dented steel lid, still sturdy enough to catch a swing. The neighborhood's least dignified shield.

armor.name: Thrift Store Trench Coat
armor.description: A long, slightly musty coat that flares nicely when you turn. Extra fabric to tangle a blade.

armor.name: Motorcycle Jacket
armor.description: Armored leather built for road rash, not blades, but it still turns aside a glancing hit.

armor.name: Riot Vest
armor.description: Scuffed padded armor left behind after a crowd dispersed. Built to shrug off thrown debris.

armor.name: Improvised Kevlar Vest
armor.description: Ballistic panels stitched into a canvas vest by someone who clearly knew what they were doing.

armor.name: Tactical Rig (Full Loadout)
armor.description: A full tactical harness plated with ceramic inserts, apparently left behind in a hurry. Serious gear for people who expected a serious fight.
